title: A relay worker holds a long watcher wait
situations: A relay-launched Claude worker or its subagent waits longer than twenty minutes.
current: Configure BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS=3600000 before the native worker starts. Keep in-turn watcher calls foreground with the documented timeout; the inherited setting protects moved commands. Explicit background calls use timeout: 3600000. If the launch setting is missing, relaunch through the launcher before starting long work; a Bash export is too late. Preserve any running call and its capture instead of duplicating it.
questions: Has a released relay-launched headless worker completed a wait longer than twenty minutes?
